versions.changelog:
Initial release with comprehensive family elder care coordination tools:

- Centralizes care responsibilities, schedules, and contacts into a structured, shareable format.
- Supports recurring and ad-hoc tasks, medication check-call schedules, and refill tracking.
- Generates doctor-visit briefing packets, care handoff summaries, meeting agendas, and emergency info sheets.
- Provides daily overviews, event logging, and tracking of trends for better visibility.
- Keeps all information in local files owned by the family—no network or accounts required.
